name: 50z
description: 50z, also known as 50 Zone, is a Blood-affiliated street gang operating on Detroit's Eastside, centered around the Gratiot and Van Dyke corridor in the 48213 zip code. The group traces its lineage to the Campanella Park Piru and operates under the 5s Nation and RedZone Bloods affiliation. It has gained wider visibility through association with Detroit rap artists including Sada Baby and Skilla Baby.

sources.title: Understanding Hybrid and Mixed-Affiliation Groups in Metro Detroit
